## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The recall-oriented threshold lives in config and a replay over recorded...

The system SHALL ensure that the recall-oriented threshold lives in config and a replay over recorded audit batches shows recall no lower than the current prompt's, with both numbers recorded.

#### Scenario: The recall-oriented threshold lives in config and a replay over recorded...

WHEN `add-a-judged-first-stage-to-coordinator-audit-triage` is implemented
THEN The recall-oriented threshold lives in config and a replay over recorded audit batches shows recall no lower than the current prompt's, with both numbers recorded.

### Requirement: Sessions below the threshold produce no LLM call, asserted by a call-count...

The system SHALL ensure that sessions below the threshold produce no LLM call, asserted by a call-count test over a clean-session fixture.

#### Scenario: Sessions below the threshold produce no LLM call, asserted by a call-count...

WHEN `add-a-judged-first-stage-to-coordinator-audit-triage` is implemented
THEN Sessions below the threshold produce no LLM call, asserted by a call-count test over a clean-session fixture.

### Requirement: Stage-two findings are seeded with the stage-one failure_type and severity...

The system SHALL ensure that stage-two findings are seeded with the stage-one failure_type and severity and still pass validate_finding unchanged.

#### Scenario: Stage-two findings are seeded with the stage-one failure_type and severity...

WHEN `add-a-judged-first-stage-to-coordinator-audit-triage` is implemented
THEN Stage-two findings are seeded with the stage-one failure_type and severity and still pass validate_finding unchanged.

### Requirement: The hot-path ring buffer write path is unmodified and its latency test is...

The system SHALL ensure that the hot-path ring buffer write path is unmodified and its latency test is unchanged.

#### Scenario: The hot-path ring buffer write path is unmodified and its latency test is...

WHEN `add-a-judged-first-stage-to-coordinator-audit-triage` is implemented
THEN The hot-path ring buffer write path is unmodified and its latency test is unchanged.
